verdict.rationale: Google Drive API supports push notifications/watch channels to monitor file/resource changes, which functions as a webhook-like subscription mechanism, but it requires polling the channel and periodic renewal rather than a full pub/sub webhook system with arbitrary event types. missing for 10: no true persistent webhook subscription API (only time-limited watch channels), no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability, no documentation of granular event-type filtering comparable to native webhooks.
